title: Evaluating and Addressing Fairness Across User Groups in Negative Sampling for Recommender Systems
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. The benchmark measures fairness disparities across user groups based on their activity levels in recommender systems.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not contain findings related to religion.
